pages.text: Envelope blocks enclose a volume. Fill it with hot air or steam and it pulls the ship up. A bigger sealed volume gives the burners more lift to work with.

pages.title: Hot Air Envelope
pages.text: Must be airtight. Blocks inside shrink the volume. Dye them. Shafts can be encased in envelope blocks to stay sealed.

pages.title: Hot Air Burner
pages.text: Redstone fills the balloon above from the top down. Set the maximum output in its panel. Several burners can feed one balloon.

pages.title: Steam Vent
pages.text: Lift from steam instead. Like a Steam Engine it needs heat, water and boiler space. See Heat in the Create basics.

Lift weakens as altitude rises, so a ship settles where lift and weight balance. Changing lift changes altitude. The Altitude Sensor outputs a redstone signal for height and, with goggles, shows air pressure. Other worlds have very different air: see $(l:space/planets)Planets$(/l).
pages.title: Altitude and air
Levitite Blend
pages.text: A fluid from heated mixing of End Stone Powder, zinc nuggets and water. Heat sets it into solid Levitite.

pages.title: Levitite
pages.text: Keeps a ship afloat but cannot gain height alone; you need other forces. It resists slow motion strongly and less so at speed.

End Stone Powder comes from crushing End Stone. Sky whale bone dust can replace it. Pearlescent Levitite is a pink variant of the same crystal. Certain blocks break when Levitite sets, which is useful for casting molds.
pages.title: Where it comes from
Related
pages.text: Heat and fluids drive burners and vents. Sky whales supply bone dust.
